map.由测量标准差与公差带求精度公差比 使用指南: Precision Tolerance Ratio from Measurement Sigma and Tolerance Band User Guide
map.输入测量标准差 s 与零件公差带 Tol，按 PTR = 6·s / Tol 计: Enter the measurement standard deviation s and the part tolerance band Tol and compute the precision tolerance ratio with PTR = 6 x s / Tol. It evaluates how much of the tolerance the gauge precision accounts for; PTR < 0.1 means the measuring equipment is fine enough.
map.输入测量标准差 s 与公差带 Tol，求 PTR。: Enter the measurement standard deviation s and the tolerance band Tol to get PTR.
map.：P/T = 6*sigma_measure / 公差（或 GRR/公差）。例：: P/T = 6 x sigma_measure / tolerance (or GRR/tolerance). Example: GRR = 0.004 and tolerance 0.1 give P/T = 24%.
map.：PTR=6×0.15/6=0.150，略高于 0.1 的推荐上限，量具精度对这: PTR = 6 x 0.15 / 6 = 0.150, slightly above the recommended limit of 0.1, so the gauge precision is tight for this tolerance and higher-precision equipment is advisable.
map.由标准不确定度与测得值求相对不确定度: Relative uncertainty from standard uncertainty and the measured value
map.由样本标准差与测量次数求 A 类标准不确定度: Type A standard uncertainty from the sample standard deviation and the number of measurements
map.P/T<10% 优，10-30% 视情况，>30% 不可接受。: Under 10% is good, 10-30% depends on the case, above 30% is unacceptable.
map.分母一为公差一为总变异。: The denominator is either the tolerance or the total variation.
